title: Weighted variational inequalities for the fractional Dunkl heat semigroup
summary: We investigate the convergence properties of the family of operators $$ \mathcal{T}_{\bf N} f(x)=\sum_{j=N_1}^{N_2} v_j\Bigl( e^{-a_{j+1}(-Δ_k)^s}f(x) - e^{-a_j(-Δ_k)^s}f(x) \Bigr), \qquad x\in\mathbb{R}^d, $$ where $\{e^{-t(-Δ_k)^s}\}_{t>0}$ denotes the fractional heat semigroup generated by the Dunkl Laplacian $Δ_k$. Here ${\bf N}=(N_1,N_2)\in\mathbb{Z}^2$, $N_1<N_2$, the coefficients $\{v_j\}_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}$ form a bounded sequence of real numbers, and $\{a_j\}_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}$ is a monotone increasing sequence of nonnegative reals.
